column1: # [FABLE-5] sq-hmd7l.24 — PINNED per-case verdicts for the vendored sparq-authored
# verdict is `pass` or a named skip bucket (`skip:imports`, `skip:condition-shape`,
# `skip:non-core`, `skip:unsupported-builtin`). The smoke lane asserts EXACT equality:
# a case drifting in EITHER direction (pass->skip regression OR skip->pass graduation)
# fails until re-pinned — pinned means pinned. Pinned SKIPs are deliberate: they pin
# the vacuity guards (an unsupported construct never launders into a pass).
